finalText:
All 625 cases pass and `verify.js` confirms it.

The bug: `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js:39-43` charged tax on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount — `applyDiscount` and the tax calc used `cents` independently instead of chaining. Fixed by computing tax on `discounted` instead of `cents`. Only rows with both a nonzero discount and tax could expose it, which is why most of the suite still passed before.
